reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; not provably public domain: William Dressler: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 001349 (the melody read from 001349a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Felix Mendelssohn's dates (1809–1847) are from our page for the tune MENDELSSOHN (content/hymns/tunes/mendelssohn.json); CCEH's page gives none.
